description: Minor material amendment to condition no. 2 (Approved Documents and Plans) of planning permission ref: PA/18/02805, Dated 25/10/2019.Minor material amendments sought:Change of use from commercial to residential on first and second floors and creation of 34 unitsConversion of residential storage area on the ground floor of block E into 3 residential unitsRemoval of basement level from blocks H and IGround floor changes to blocks H and IHeight increase by circa 350mm to blocks C and ERoof height increase of between 150mm to 300mm to block M townhousesRemoval of 19 car parking spaces, including the removal of 18 garage spaces from the ground floor of block M townhousesGround floor changes to block M townhouses, including conversion of garage parking space to studio/ office living spaceSlight fenestration changes to block M fenestration along the northern elevation of townhouses and western elevation of the office blockSet back of building footpring by 2m at the eastern boundary of the site including reduction in size of the two-storey extension of block H by 38.9sqm and the omission of single-storey extension of block IChanges to balcony locations and type, fenestration changes, creation of additional balconies and changes to roof fenestration to blocks H and ISlight fenestration changes to block A along the eastern elevationRemoval of a set of two windows on all floors on the eastern elevation of block E.This application is accompanied by an Environmental Statement.
